OnePlus DASH fast-charge microcontroller

Required properties:
- compatible: must be "microchip,oneplus_fastcg"
- reg: I2C slave address
- microchip,mcu-en-gpio: MCU reset/enable GPIO
- microchip,usb-sw-1-gpio: first USB data-switch GPIO
- microchip,usb-sw-2-gpio: second USB data-switch GPIO
- microchip,ap-clk: AP-to-MCU clock GPIO
- microchip,ap-data: MCU-to-AP data and rising-edge interrupt GPIO
- pinctrl-names: must contain "mux_fastchg_active",
  "mux_fastchg_suspend", "mcu_data_active", and "mcu_data_suspend"
- pinctrl-0 through pinctrl-3: states corresponding to pinctrl-names

The driver obtains the active-only SNOC and CNOC MSM bus voter clocks from
the MSM8998 RPM clock provider. They are intentionally not consumer DT
properties.
